title: Backups and Rescue save
summary: Get a campaign back when something went wrong.

sections.heading: Backups
steps: The tool makes a backup of your campaign after every save, in the save-backups folder.
It keeps the last 10 for each save.
A copy is also kept before a save first runs with another mod list.

sections.heading: Restore a backup
steps: Open the Saves page and click Restore save backup.
Pick the backup and click Restore. Your current save is kept as a backup first.

sections.heading: Rescue save
steps: Start server already fixes known save problems. Use Rescue save when support asks, or when lords are stuck with an empty party.
Click Stop server, then Run Rescue save on the Logs page. Do not click Start server yourself.
The tool starts the server with the rescue, fixes the save and saves it.
When it says Done, click Stop server, then Start server to play normally.
sections.tip: The ? next to Run Rescue save shows these steps. Still broken? Click Send my logs and post the code in Discord.
